title: Warbit
tagline: Create Warriors, Battle Opponents, Earn Tokens. Warbit, an arcade game house powered by metal.build
description:
Warbit is an innovative gaming platform that combines nostalgic arcade-style gameplay with modern blockchain technology, creating a unique "play-to-earn" experience without the typical Web3 friction. Players create personalized warrior characters, each backed by their own token on the Base Mainnet, and battle other warriors in skill-based arcade mini-games to win tokens and climb the leaderboards.

Tokenized Warriors
At the heart of Warbit is the revolutionary integration with Metal.build, which enables seamless tokenization without requiring users to manage wallets, pay gas fees, or understand complex blockchain transactions. When you create your warrior:

You choose a unique warrior name and token symbol (e.g., "Pixel Crusher" with $PIXL token)
The platform automatically mints your personal warrior token on the Base Mainnet
Your token becomes the in-game currency you use to battle and the prize others can win
All blockchain complexity is abstracted away - no MetaMask, no seed phrases, no gas fees!
Elemental System
Warriors in Warbit are aligned with one of four primal elements, each with unique characteristics that influence gameplay:

Fire Warriors: Aggressive combatants with high-risk, high-reward gameplay styles
Water Warriors: Fluid and adaptable, with balanced offensive and defensive capabilities
Air Warriors: Swift and elusive, specializing in speed-based challenges
Earth Warriors: Resilient and powerful, excelling in endurance-focused battles
Your elemental choice affects both your warrior's visual appearance and subtle gameplay mechanics in the arcade battles.

Arcade Battle System
Warbit features a variety of skill-based mini-games inspired by classic arcade titles:

Elemental Runner: A side-scrolling runner game where you jump over obstacles, with element-specific visuals and challenges
Rock-Paper-Scissors Battle: A strategic game of prediction and counter-prediction with arcade-style animations
More games coming soon!: The platform is designed to expand with additional arcade challenges
When you challenge another warrior:

Both players stake an agreed amount of their tokens
You compete in the selected arcade game
The winner claims both their original stake and their opponent's tokens
Results are recorded on the leaderboard, building your warrior's reputation
Tokenomics & Rewards
The Warbit economy is designed to be self-sustaining and player-driven:

Each warrior's token has real value on the Base Mainnet
Tokens can be won through successful battles
The more battles you win, the more tokens you accumulate
Future features will include token trading, enhanced liquidity options, and special tournament prizes
All powered by Metal.build's infrastructure, making blockchain interactions invisible to players
Community & Competition
Warbit isn't just about individual battles - it's about building a vibrant community of warriors:

Global leaderboards track the most successful warriors
Element-based factions compete for dominance
Regular tournaments offer special rewards and recognition
Social features allow players to form alliances and rivalries
The Vision
Warbit represents the future of Web3 gaming - where blockchain technology enhances the gaming experience without complicating it. By combining the accessibility and fun of arcade games with the economic opportunities of tokenization, Warbit creates a platform where skill, strategy, and a bit of luck determine who rises to the top of the warrior ranks.

Join the battle today, create your warrior, mint your token, and prove your skills in the arena - no crypto experience required!
how_its_made: Warbit is built using metal.build api endpoints for web3 interactions, Next.js for front-end and Supabase for handling its database connections. Endpoints on metal.build help users to create tokens, create helper wallets and distribute these tokens without signing any transaction on Base Mainnet and connecting any wallet. Next.js is used to make it clean,, game-like design and Supabase is chosen to manage the data entries easily.
